message: `check` needs at least one model file or directory
description: `va-cli check` compiles Verilog-A models without simulating them, so it needs to be told which models. None was given: only flags, or nothing at all, followed `check`.
actions: Name one or more `.va`/`.vams` files or directories: `va-cli check models/diode.va` or `va-cli check models/`.
Add `--codegen` to also check that each model can be compiled for simulation.
